d.t: SPACER TAB FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM FOR RAISED PAVERS FLOORING
d.s: SikaRoof VersiJack K Spacer Tab is an accessory used on top of adjustable pedestals to create precise and uniform gaps for the alignment of pavers in raised flooring systems. Spacer tabs are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP) and it has four breakable tabs to support four paver corners that rest on top of the adjustable pedestal. SikaRoof VersiJack K Spacer Tab is used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiJack K and may be manufactured with tabs of various thicknesses to create varying drainage gaps sizes, to support concrete pavers, stone pavers, and porcelain tiles that have a minimum thickness of 20 mm.
a: Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Spacer tabs are used with adjustable pedestals for raised pavers flooring on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.
